linkedin.text: Day Zero Year 1 was a success! It was such an honor to present on the keynote stage this Monday at CrowdStrike’s first Day Zero Threat Research Summit. I really enjoyed the talks, the conversations, and the many people I had the chance to meet throughout the conference.
